exposure: Discrimination based on specific patient socio-demographic attributes
Medicalization-related variables (indication for cesarean sections and induction)
Supportive care, in particular the mobilization dimension
cohort: 876 births included in the BaBi birth cohort study set in Bielefeld, Germany, between 2013 and 2016
finding: Putting more emphasis on the completeness of standardized data could increase their potential for vBI-related research.
